svg.title: How a release reaches the Chrome Web Store
svg.desc: After every release, every day at 00:17 UTC and when started by hand with a tag, the workflow signs in to the Chrome Web Store and asks for the state of the item. A sign-in that Google turns away, a rejected release, a warning, a takedown or a review of more than 7 days fail the run, with the reason and the fix in its summary, and the bot-health sweep of the night keeps an issue open. While a review is pending, the run ends with a note, and a later day delivers the release. When the store has the release already, nothing happens. Otherwise a job without any secret builds the zip from the tag and keeps it as an artifact, and a job that reaches only Google uploads it and submits it for review.
